description: 한국수력원자력(주)_원자력발전소 입지현황 [nuclear facilities and electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수력원자력(주). 한국수력원자력(주)이 제공하는 “원자력발전소 입지현황” 데이터는 국내 원자력발전소의 위치, 설비 규모, 운영 현황 등을 한눈에 파악하도록 정리한 공공데이터이며, 산업·통상·중소기업. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
